The '''Degarian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Southern Core]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Degarian II]]''.<ref name="Only Witness">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Only Witness]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Degarian system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
